🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 23, 2026

Moon, exalted in Taurus, holds an opposition to Mercury, in Scorpio. Nothing in common except the angle they hold: the wanting and the sum are audible in the same room.

Easier — Noticing which of your commitments you never actually chose.
Harder — Forcing a decision that only needs to be described honestly.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars rules you from Leo, untitled. Venus faces you from Libra, holding the other figures. Cardinal fire: the beginning has a price on it. After two weeks of the same angle, the terms are familiar.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is on home ground in Libra. Moon is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Earth holds on until the thing and the self are one. Four weeks of this, and none of it is news.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio untitled. Venus in Libra trines you: agreement arrives before the argument. Air that changes shape, and the shape fits. The hold Pluto had a week ago is not there any more.

♋ CANCER
Moon governs you, honoured in Taurus. From Scorpio, Mercury concedes the point early. Cardinal water: the opening move is the cheap one. The sextile to Saturn that held a week ago has let go.

♌ LEO
Sun governs you, untitled in Sagittarius. Moon squares you from Taurus, and the cost objects. Fixed fire: the grip costs more than the thing. Four weeks of Scorpio ended, and nothing carried over.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Moon trines you from Taurus, meeting no resistance. Mutable earth keeps two accounts, and both balance. Mercury went direct two weeks ago; the re-reading is over.

♎ LIBRA
Venus governs you, at home in Libra. Mars sextiles you from Leo: help that waits to be asked for. Cardinal air opens the account without argument. Sun let go of it four weeks ago.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. From Taurus, Moon returns your estimate with corrections. Water holds on, and the holding is billed. Two weeks ago Mars was still held by Moon; that is finished.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Sun crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Mutable fire: the two accounts collapse into one. Four weeks in, and the shape of it is no longer a surprise.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Moon trines you from Taurus, and the ease asks its own attention. Earth begins, and beginning asks little today. It has held four weeks without changing its terms.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn governs you, unsupported in Aries. Moon in Taurus presses on you, and the pressure is arithmetic. Air keeps its grip past the point it is worth. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. From Taurus, Moon makes something possible and nothing certain. Water bends, and bending costs nothing here. The square of two weeks ago is off it now.
